A young man with a sword kills most of the wildlife in this region in a myth before being admonished by a creature that can disappear into its own alternate dimension. After saving its life, Damos was given a jewel formed from five elemental plates by the creator of this region. Three guardian spirits of this region are based on the Imperial Regalia of Japan and dwell in lakes (*) Acuity, Verity, and Valor. A story from this region explains that the mutual assistance and friendship between Pokemon and humans is why Pokemon appear in tall grass. Many of this region's myths are collected in the library of Canalave City and are studied by its Pokemon League Champion Cynthia. For 10 points, what is this region, the setting of the fourth generation Pokemon games?

A secret weapon in this game is a destructive red foam finger. The Elite Advanced Suit can be obtained on a second playthrough of this game. The protagonist of this game is revealed to be a subject of Project Telomere, and at the end of this game a figure called The Overseer states that the other sites must "pick up the pieces". One death scene in this game shows the protagonist being stabbed through the eye by the NoonTech Diagnostic Machine. One boss in this game is the (*) gigantic Tormentor, who can trample the player. Before the final boss battle in this game, which takes place in the protagonist's mind, the player character stabs Hans Tiedmann with a javelin and screams "FUCK YOU! AND FUCK YOUR MARKER!" at a hallucination of his dead girlfriend, Nicole Brennan. Daina Le Guin is revealed to be a member of the Church of Unitology in this game, which takes place on the Sprawl, a space station overrun by Necromorphs. FTP, name this 2011 survival horror sequel in which Isaac Clarke returns to fight off hordes of zombies.

One member of this race is a journalist who foolishly takes pictures of a creature known as the "Yoob," which tries to eat her before immediately spitting her out. Another member of this race crafts the haiku "Like the moon over/the day, my genius and brawn/are lost on these fools." One hoodie-wearing member of this race of creatures mistakenly believes he has discovered the skeleton of his father, but soon realizes that it is instead the father of a different member of this race, an archaeologist named (*) Kolorado. The leader of this race frequently rides around in a copter decorated with a clown face, and that leader is sometimes joined by a group of seven siblings who include Ludwig, Iggy, and Lemmy. The "red" version of these creatures do not walk off cliffs, unlike the ones with green shells. For 10 points, identify this race of turtle-like creatures who antagonize Mario.
3.r: Koopa Troopa [generously prompt on things like the turtle-like creatures from Mario]

3.q: In a game subtitled for one of these locales, the Brotherhood of the Seth meets the player at High Rock before a quest to the Crypt of Hearts, and visions from Ria Silmane help the player find pieces of the Staff of Chaos. A yellow-haired Adoring Fan can follow you after you become Grand Champion of the one in Oblivion. For 10 points, name these locales which lend their name to the first Elder Scrolls game, such as the building in the Imperial City where audiences watch staged battles.
3.r: arenas [or the Arena; accept The Elder Scrolls I : Arena; accept Imperial City Arena; generously prompt on “colosseums” or “stadiums”]

3.q: An out-of-place pop song plays during a cutscene in this game in which a girl wearing a white sweater clings to the protagonist during a motorcycle ride. The protagonist of this game is lured to a seemingly empty arcade, where a "skinhead" eats his boat ticket. Cassette tapes found throughout this game can be played at a hot dog cart owned by the dancing American Rastafari Tom. After beating this game once, it is possible to play again with the "Actual Weather" settings, based on real meteorological records collected from 1986-87. After being betrayed by their leader Terry Ryan, the protagonist of this game fights in a seventy-person melee against the entire (*) Mad Angels gang. The most-mocked aspect of this game is the roughly three in-game hours devoted to the protagonist's job operating a forklift. This game ends with the protagonist traveling to Hong Kong in pursuit of Lan Di, to avenge his father's murder in the family dojo. For 10 points, name this hilariously realistic 1999 open-world Dreamcast game starring Ryo Hazaki.

In this series, the player can call Private Kowalski and his dead brother "a little bitch" after shooting a war memorial. One DLC in this series involves cooperating with a cowboy, a samurai and a little girl to commandeer an alien spaceship, Mothership Zeta. In this series, Caesar ("KAI-sar") justifies his namesake legion with Hegelian Dialectics. A weapon in this series called the (*) "Fat Man" can lob mini nukes at enemies like deathclaws and ghouls. A giant war robot in this series spouts patriotic slogans like "Democracy is Non-Negotiable" and "Death is a Preferable Alternative to Communism." For 10 points, name this retro-futuristic post-apocalyptic role-playing game series which is named after residual radioactive material.
3.r: Fallout [accept Fallout 1 or Fallout 2 or Fallout 3 or Fallout New Vegas or Fallout 4 or Fallout 76; prompt on New Vegas]

3.q: Unlockable examples of these items are shaped like a fish, a log, the USA, and a "snaketapus." A character based on the likeness of Jack Black wields a battle axe and one of these objects on the cover art of Brutal Legend. The protagonist of Rush's "2112" finds one of these objects near a waterfall, a story retold in a game starring the headless Austin Tejas and the robotic Echo Tesla. Bonnie from (*) Five Nights at Freddy's is sometimes shown holding one of these objects. Harmonix created a video game franchise named after these objects, which are simulated by controllers with green, red, yellow, blue, and orange buttons and a whammy bar. For 10 points, name these instruments featured in a namesake "Hero" video game franchise, in which you can play along to "Sweet Child O' Mine" and "Smoke on the Water."

A boy trying to hear "the voice of a slot machine" instead hears this creature crying out for help after it crashes into the forest. In a different appearance, Carr, Orm, and Sird wreak havoc on islands inhabited by Celio and the old woman Kimberly in an attempt to attract this creature. In that appearance, this creature is captured while trying to heal in its "black delta" and is referred to as "Organism One." In a film appearance, this creature causes auroras to appear over LaRousse city while fighting its rival before almost being smothered by (*) cube robots. This creature is variously summoned by moving around a triangle on Birth Island or from a triangular object found inside an asteroid. Because it comes from space, touching a meteorite in Nacrene City or Veilstone City will change this creature to its Attack, Defense, and Speed Formes. For 10 points, name this Pokemon who often fights with Rayquaza and who is named after DNA.
3.r: Deoxys (The first line refers to the Deoxys bonus episode in the DP arc of Pokémon Adventures! The second and third lines are from the FireRed & LeafGreen arc. The film referenced is Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys.)

3.q: One of these figures was originally depicted holding star rods with inverse mirrors in the stars; however, modern depictions show those stars with opaque white light. In the initial language in which these figures were detailed, they are called "Tico" as a reference to Tycho Brahe. Four green varieties of these figures inhabit a tripod-like planet with orange, blue, and green ends known as the Planet of Trials. The only black variety of these figures serves as a celestial navigator and is named Polari. One type of these figures transforms into large celestial bodies with names such as "Bigmouth" and "Sling Pod." Those figures of this type hold rods with either coins or (*) star bits on the end and are called "hungry." These figures are the main inhabitants of the Comet Observatory. A notable one of these figures gives a man the ability to spin and lives under his red hat. For 10 points, name this celestial star-like beings that are cared for by Rosalina and star in the Super Mario Galaxy games.

This game introduced the long-running joke of whether a two sided ladder should be called a "ladder" or a "step-ladder." One character specializes in delivering lunches and is nicknamed the "Cough-Up Queen." In this game, you prove that a balloon that was being inflated by an air tank is the actual "Gourdy" in a part in which you use a metal detector to prove that a villain still had a (*) bullet in his shoulder. This game, which has an additional fifth chapter for the DS remake, includes a wealthy character who makes up words like "fantabulistic" in order to seem smart, named Redd White, in its second case, in which The Thinker statue is again used as a murder weapon. For 10 points, name this Capcom game which introduced a lawyer who shouts "Objection!"
3.c: 2013 Western Invitational Tournament Pkt GMU + Sheffield A + Chicago C Q13

3.q: Alexander Galloway analysed this series in a 2004 Radical Philosophy article titled 'Playing the Code'. It's not Western-themed, but a September 2019 update to this series released a post-apocalyptic multiplayer mode called Red Death. Advisors in one entry in this series include one modelled on Elvis. As all integers in C and C++ are signed, a (*) bug in the first game in this series cannot exist, according to its creator. A possibly apocryphal "nuclear Gandhi" may have featured in the first game of this series, which allows players to control various empires from the Ancient until the Information eras. For 10 points, name this series of 4X games created by Sid Meier.
3.r: Civilization [or Civ; accept any specific games in the series such as Civ (ilization) V or Civ Six]

3.q: This character created the AegisCam system for his uncle's precious metals company. This figure shouts "I can see the look on their stupid faces!" after his teammate diverts a train into a weapons depot. He meets his love interest Amanda immediately before the invasion of Emperor Anglar, and shouts "Your carcass is mine!" during an attack on the defense satellite (*) Bolse. This character's father developed a self-destruct program to be used against the Aparoids, and together, this character and his father, Beltino, worked for Space Dynamics helping to develop weapons for the Cornerian army. This best friend of ROB64 and inventor of the Landmaster and Blue Marine is the teammate of Falco, Peppy, and Fox. For 10 points, name this amphibious member of the Star Fox team.

In this game, the whispered line "I just look in the mirror and don't know who I'm looking at" is included in a reversed monologue that plays when the player enters a mirror. Speedrunning techniques for this game includes "demodashing" directly through walls of dust bunnies and hypering off Kevin blocks. Players of this game are twice required to keep a golden feather within a slowly rising box to slow the protagonist's (*) breathing. That protagonist attempts to clean up an abandoned resort before being chased away by a big-headed ghost in this game, whose soundtrack was composed by Lena Raine. Mr. Oshiro and the amateur photographer Theo appear in this game, whose purple-haired antagonist is the embodiment of the protagonist's anxiety. For 10 points, name this 2018 platformer in which Madeline confronts her mental health issues while climbing the title mountain.

In one appearance, this character induces sleep in their opponents by creating a "negative zone", though this move replaced by a move featuring the "Poltergust" in a sequel. This driver of the "Streamliner" racing car enlists the help of Elvin Gadd to help him remove ghosts from his (*) mansion in one game. Satoru Iwata declared 2013 to be the "year of [this character]", who is mainly known as a side character, though he made his main character debut in the NES game Mario is Missing. For 10 points, name this green-wearing younger brother of Super Mario.
3.r: Luigi [do not accept or prompt on “Mario” or “green Mario”]

3.q: One city in this province was successfully defended when Cyril Vinticae noticed that his defence force were in league with the marauding ice tribes. The capital of this province is ruled from The Blue Palace by Elisif the Fair. This province saw a civil war between the (*) Imperial Legion and the Stormcloaks, the latter of whom are based in Windhelm. This province was troubled by the return of dragons until Alduin was defeated by the Dovahkiin. For 10 points, name this province of Tamriel which is the home of the Nords and the setting of the fifth main series Elder Scrolls game.
3.r: Skyrim [accept Mereth, accept Keizaal, do not accept or prompt on “Tamriel”]

3.q: One boss in this game, Rollodillo, is felled by attacking his vulnerable backside, while another boss, Megahammer, must be defeated by shooting the bullets he fires back at him. Locations in this game include the Tall Trunk, which contains a giant slide. New power-ups in this game include the Blimp Berry and one that allows players to bowl (*) over enemies as a boulder. In between levels, the player can explore a home base in the shape of the hero's face, while players who repeatedly fail a level can be aided by a guide in the form of a character from its predecessor, Rosalina. It also retained feeding starbits to Lumas to open up new levels. Unlike the original, players can now ride Yoshi. For 10 points, name this sequel to a critically acclaimed Wii platforming game.

In one card game, playing an Alchemist lets you do this twice, while playing a Caravan lets you do this when you play it and at the beginning of your next turn. Other cards that let you do this action twice in that card game include Moat and Laboratory. In several games, including Dominion, cards which let you do this once when you play them are referred to as "cantrips." In Magic: the Gathering, the artifact Howling Mine causes all players to take this action an additional time per turn, and one of that game's so-called "Power Nine", (*) Ancestral Recall, causes you to do this action three times. In Uno, if a player cannot play, they must do this until they are able to make a legal play. In a variety of poker named for this action, players can discard any number of cards from their hand and then perform this action that many times. For 10 points, identify this action often taken in card games to increase one's hand size.
3.r: drawing a card [accept drawing any arbitrary number of cards such as drawing three cards]

3.q: One game released by this publisher stars a football team sent back in time to save the title character from Morgana. In another of its publications, the player alternately controls an angel and an animated statue and assaults the fortress of Death Heim after fighting the six guardians of Tanzra; in that game, the Master is tasked with rebuilding various civilizations. This publisher of King Arthur and the Knights of Justice also published the original version of a game in which the player collects einherjar while controlling Lenneth, one of their many collaborations with tri-Ace. This publisher of ActRaiser, (*) Valkyrie Profile, and the first three Star Ocean games also published the first seven entries in a series of RPGs produced by Yuji Horii. For 10 points, name this publisher of the Dragon Quest series that, in 2003, merged with Square.
3.r: the Enix Corporation [accept Kabushiki-gaisha Enikkusu from insufferable people; don’t accept “Square Enix” as none of the games are Square Enix games]

3.q: One enemy in this video game disguises himself as a maiden, but when exposed to daylight he is revealed to be a monstrous thief named Blind. The protagonist of this game is told to acquire the three Pendants of Virtue by a man who can later be contacted through telepathic panels, Sahasrahla. The protagonist of this game receives the (*) sword and shield from his dying uncle, and uses the Magic Mirror to teleport himself out of the Dark World. The Dark World contains a massive pyramid at its center, in which the game's hero fights the final boss, Ganon. For 10 points, identify this game, whose hero must rescue the seven maidens and defeat the wizard Agahnim, the third game in the Zelda series.
3.r: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past [or Zeruda no Densetsu: Kamigami no Toraifosu; do not accept or prompt on "Zelda" or "The Legend of Zelda" by itself]
3.c: 2013 VCU Closed Pkt Chicago B & Yale B Q9

3.q: One boss in this game guarded a stone vault opened up by standing on four pillars; that boss was Eyerok. Shifting Sand Land is in this game, another level of which features a sliding puzzle with the face of the antagonist and is called Lethal Lava Land. Wed-Dry World and Tiny-Huge Island appear in this game where the (*) Dark World, the Fire Sea, and the Sky are all locations for fights with the final boss, the last of which can only be accessed by going up the Endless Steps. In a later game, the Throwback Galaxy was a remake of one of this game's levels where you defeat the Whomp King. In this game, you can get an upgraded triple jump from Yoshi on the roof, after getting 120 power stars from jumping into paintings. For 10 points, name this revolutionary 3-D N64 game where you had to rescue Princess Peach.

At one point in this game, the player can receive the Alien Medal from a group of squid. To do so, the player must take no damage in a fight against Ironhead, a character from this game's developer's earlier title Ikachan. After escaping from jail, the player is asked to collect a sprinkler and a controller to build a rocket for Momorin Sakamoto. This game contains a bonus stage called "Sacred Ground", where the protagonist fights Jenka's brother Ballos, the creator of the Demon Crown. For 10 points, identify this 2004 platformer, independently developed entirely by Daisuke Amaya under the alias "Pixel", which takes its name from its setting, the interior of a floating island.
3.c: 2010 Minnesota Open Pkt zFinals 2 - DO NOT READ FOR PRELIMS Q18

3.q: In Zone of the Enders, this ability is uniquely possessed by the Anubis and Hathor frames, though Djehuty later acquires it. In Metal Gear Solid: Portable Ops, Gene uses a knife and this ability to kill Ursula, and in that game it is referred to as "zero shift." This ability is granted by a dagger costing 2150 gold in Defense of the Ancients, and in Diablo II, this ability is granted via the Enigma runeword armor. 3.r: teleportation or warp or blink [accept equivalents, accept “Zero Shift” before mention; do NOT accept “super-speed” or “going really fast” or equivalents; do NOT accept “invisibility” or “cloaking” or equivalents]

3.q: An evil lumberjack named Jacques Le Sheets is the villain of a game starring a "kamikaze squirrel" of this name for the Sega Genesis. For 10 points, give this number that titles a racing series featuring Captain Falcon.

One of the characters from this video game series sleeps with a deity for 88 days straight, resulting in many spirits returning from the dead to feast upon the "pomegranate banquet." Four signs including "Fire from the Eye of Glass" and "Tide of Woe" predate a hunting event from this game series, which occurs only once every era. A realm from this game series undergoes an event called Greymarch at the end of every era due to the emergence of Forces of Order. For 10 points, name this video game series featuring Daedric lords such as Hircine and Azura, whose most recent entries include Oblivion and Skyrim.

3.q: The studio behind this game commissioned Max Brooks, author of World War Z, to write a novelization of this game subtitled "The Island." When an Evoker is killed in this game, it drops an item that prevents the player from dying by restoring them to 1 health. Certain items in this game disappear upon death when the Curse of Vanishing is applied to them. An April 2019 update to this game added the (*) "Bad Omen" status effect, which triggers a pillager raid when a player enters villages. Those villages are generated structures in this game where players can trade emeralds for items like ender pearls and redstone. In 2017, Microsoft bought this game for $2.5 billion from Markus Persson, also known as "Notch." For 10 points, surviving the night against skeletons and mining diamonds are objectives of what Mojang-created block-centric sandbox game?

One game developed by this company allows you to select seven different "Planet Runners" as a mercenary for a mining company, and another game developed by this company sees Emperor Zizzy Ballooba attempt to destroy the Earth. In addition to Shattered Steel and MDK2, this company is developing the "Eclipse Engine" for use in Dragon Age: Origins. Another game by this developer asks the player to choose between The Way of the Open Palm and The Way of the Closed Fist, and the protagonist is accompanied by Sagacious Zu and Dawn Star. Another game by this company sees the player cure the Wailing Death and defeat Morag inside the Source Stone and features the (*) Aurora toolset. This is more famous for a game in which the Reapers attempt to destroy all life with Saren's help, and another in which the player discovers that he is Darth Revan. For 10 points, name this game company famous for Jade Empire, Neverwinter Nights, depicting Commander Shepard in Mass Effect, and Knights of the Old Republic.
3.c: 2009 Chicago Open Pkt 09 - In Vinokurov Veritas Q11

3.q: Paul McBurney designed a spinoff of this video game played in real-time; Eighty Clicks is another spinoff of this game. The Youtuber Tom Davies gained popularity as the "wizard" of this game, sometimes imposing challenges such as not clicking or not (*) moving from one's starting location. Anton Wallen designed this game, which generally scores rounds from zero to five thousand based on the player's distance from the target. Mapillary and Google Street View are used by, for 10 points, what geography-based internet game?

3.r: the murders from Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc [accept equivalents, such as the killings at Hope’s Peak Academy; do not accept or prompt on answers indicating the crimes happened in Danganronpa 2 or other entries in the series]

3.q: One side-quest in this game requires the player to retrieve a cage containing a rare insect and bring it back to a man who screams "THANK YOU" whenever you purchase something from him. One boss in this game requires using the whip to unscrew him and is a six-armed, Buddha-like automaton named Koloktos. After failing to protect his love interest, Groose builds a bomb catapult on rails to guard a sealed (*) temple, and the second part of this game requires the player to purify a legendary weapon with three sacred flames. The events of this game are set in motion with the appearance of a tornado sent by the villainous Ghirahim and the disappearance of a blonde maiden, and this game's hub world is explored by flying around on a Loftwing. Famed for its one-to-one controls with Motion Plus, for 10 points, identify this Wii game in which Link descends from the clouds with the title blade, the latest entry in the Legend of Zelda series.

Series or either of two individual games in that series is acceptable. Music from Mozart's 40th symphony plays while the protagonist roams the halls in one game; that game pits the user against a CD-launching robot and a live wire named LiveWire. Another game takes place in a Technology Center and requires the user to deploy (*) bananas to induce sleep in parts-stealing Cyberchimps. 3.q: The expanded universe lead-up into this game saw Whitcomb sacrifice himself to lure an enemy fleet to the Unyielding Hierophant. That playable character is betrayed and meets the (*) main playable character - who had just killed the Prophet of Regret - in the clutches of the Gravemind. It ends with the death of Tartarus the Brute Chieftain and a Civil War in the Covenant when the Elites ally themselves with the UNSC. This game that allowed dual wielding was the most popular game on Xbox Live until Gears of War came out two years after it. For 10 points, name this Bungie FPS that was the sequel to a game with Master Chief subtitled Combat Evolved.

During one tournament for this activity, Gimix decided to throw two games to a Ukrainian player then sponsored by Duckload, because the extended-series rule put him ahead. In 2011, the same two players faced each other in best of seven series at both Dreamhack Winter and NASL Season Two Grand Finals: Liquid'Hero and EGPuma. For 10 points, name this second installment in a Blizzard RTS series where players can be Terran, Protoss, or Zerg.
3.r: Starcraft II [prompt on “Starcraft” because who plays vanilla Starcraft I?]

For 10 points, name this long-running series of video games from Omega Force and Koei, a brawler in which the player selects various personages from the Three Kingdoms Era of China.
3.c: 2014 Chicago Open History Doubles Pkt 06 Q15

3.r: Midgar [or Middogaru; accept the Midgar slums; before “Wall Market” is read, prompt on Wall Market by asking “what city is that a part of?”; reject “Midgard”]

3.q: Categories of speedrun in this game include Missing Bundle, Movie Theater, and Restoration. In this game, a Galaxy Hammer can be combined with galaxy souls to make an Infinity Gavel.
